replay_safety.notes: Reads one seeded invoice record; writes nothing.

claim.statement: Authorization (IDOR) on api.example.test: any signed-in user can read another user's invoice metadata by changing the numeric invoice ID in GET /v2/invoices/{id}.
claim.effect: read of another user's invoice metadata (owner, amount, due date)

severity.method: CVSS v4.0 base metrics derived from the validated preconditions (PR:L, network) and the identity-differential result.

oracle.bounded_output: HTTP status and the owner_id field of the response body; nothing else is read or kept.

positive_control.description: Owner (identity 'owner') reads their own invoice 48213 and receives 200 with owner_id=owner.

identities.description: seeded test user who owns invoice 48213
a second seeded test user with no relation to invoice 48213

investigation.source: invoices/handlers.py: get_invoice() loads by id without an owner filter (as observed in the lab build)
investigation.config: gateway route policy 'invoices-read' requires a session but no object-level check

baseline.description: Reader requests their own invoice 48299 and receives 200 with owner_id=reader.

negative.description: The same request with no Authorization header returns 401.

positive.description: Owner reads invoice 48213 and receives 200 with owner_id=owner.

expected_difference.statement: If the finding is real, the reader receives 200 and an owner_id that is not theirs. If it is fixed, the reader receives 403 or 404.
expected_difference.decision_rule: Finding present if and only if status == 200 and body.owner_id != the reader's own id.

cleanup.item: seeded invoices 48213 and 48299 for the two test identities

unique.reason: Claim key GET /v2/invoices/{int} | auth=user | sink=object-read has no earlier record.
unique.alternative_ruled_out: Not the /v1 route already on the list: /v1 enforces the owner check in the lab build (catalog A6).

true.reason: Identity differential: reader received owner's record; owner positive control and unauthenticated negative control behaved as expected.
true.alternative_ruled_out: Not the tester's own data (F3): the two seeded identities share nothing, and the response was not cached (no Age or cache-status header).

actionable.reason: Owner pre-staged from the service's code-owners entry: invoice service team.
actionable.alternative_ruled_out: Not a vendor-held layer: the handler is first-party code.

new.reason: No prior report, risk acceptance or VEX statement matches the claim key.
new.alternative_ruled_out: Not a regression of a closed item: no fixed item shares the key.

scope.statement: 1 of 40 invoice IDs proven; the other 39 share the claim key and are listed, not tested.

review.remediation: Filter the invoice lookup by the caller's owner id (or tenant) in get_invoice(), and return 404 for objects the caller does not own.
review.verify_replay: Run the same replay as the reader: expect 403 or 404. Run it as the owner: expect 200.
